featured_reviews.name: Simi Vinod
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re searching for a fitness experience that’s energizing, uplifting, and expertly guided, look no further than Galaxy Studio’s Zumba and aerial yoga classes. What truly sets this place apart is the incredible trainer, Gaurav.

Gaurav brings unmatched energy to the Zumba sessions—his choreography is fun, dynamic, and easy to follow no matter your experience level. He knows exactly how to read the room, pushing you when you need it, and cheering you on every step of the way. There’s never a dull moment; with Gaurav leading, you forget it’s a workout and just enjoy the rhythm.

And then there’s aerial yoga—equal parts graceful and empowering. Gaurav’s guidance here is calm, clear, and confidence-boosting. He pays attention to every individual’s form and makes sure you feel supported and safe as you stretch, flip, and float your way through each pose. It’s like he has this sixth sense for knowing exactly what each student needs to progress.

Whether you’re dancing your heart out or hanging upside down, Gaurav transforms every session into a personal triumph. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to move with joy and grow stronger in body and mind.

featured_reviews.name: Zelda Kolah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Holi, a festival of colours. to celebrate love, community and arrival of spring, PHAGUN as we know in Hindi.
While the entire country rejoiced it with wet and dry colours and water, we celebrated it yesterday at Natanam with the colours of classical music and dance - ‘Baithak’ A mesmerising evening, started with a resounding Pakhwanj recital by Pranay Sakpal and Arjun Shinde, disciples of Shri Sukhad Mundeji, setting the mood and creating a platitude atmosphere.

For the first time I heard Khayal and Thumris renditions by Jayanti Nayak ma’am while our Kathak Sir Prakash Raj emoting it with amazing expressions. They were accompanied by Vaibhav Mankad on harmonium and Kaushik Basu on tabla.

Guru Shubhada with her disciples Mitali and Shreya displayed  the naughtiness of Krishna, the spiritual form of Shiva through Odissi dance form.

This was followed by a  Bharatnatyam performance my Guru Nilesh Singha. His performance started with a recital spreading the message of universal brotherhood - “Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam”, the world is one family.
He performed an Ashtapadi which is a Divine Romance between Shree Krisha and Radha celebrating the augmentation of Vasant.

The show ended with a finale by junior and senior kathak students who danced on the phagun songs. Both the Kathak compositions were wrtitten by Padmashri Dr Puru Dadheech, Piyush Sir’s Guru.

Had it not been for Natanam, I wouldn’t have got a chance to witness such amazing performances by these senior artists.
I am surely looking forward to learn my dance form and perform soon. Thank you  Natanam for taking this initiative of Baithak.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks a lot for this wonderful review and the photos. We are truly delighted that you could attend this Baithak and experience the joy of Indian classical dance and music. Thank you.🙏🙏

Whether you’re looking to learn a new dance style or just want to get moving, this studio is definitely worth checking out. Highly recommend!

Despite informing the class in advance that my child would not be wearing the class T‑shirt, my child was made to sit out for the entire class and was not allowed to dance. The T‑shirt is made of nylon, which is very uncomfortable for children in summer.
A dance class is meant to encourage and teach, not punish or publicly embarrass children. This incident had a negative emotional impact on my child.

Truly a wonderful place for  all age groups.

Dance instructors keep childrens highly engaged with emphasis on learning fundamentals alongside having fun with laughter.
Focuses is on the right kind of posture.

Instructors at DWD are themselves incredible dancers,
Each  has their own unique style of imparting training to children in a safe, funfilled, learning oriented atmosphere.

Feeling proud to speak about DWD team......

+ Monty Sir :- Very skilled,
works tirelessly with boundless energy.
unique combination of enormous love for dance & the passion to deliver support & guidance forever, teach each child at their own space with patience.

+ Chirag Sir :-
He not only teach dance steps but develop confidence & self expression, encourage kids to turn fear into passions.

Training imparted kids with knowledge on how to use facial expressions that match with dance music.

What a beauty, spirituality & cultural heritage we received in the form of dance through DWD!!
All out together kudos to DWD for this graceful showcase & look forward to many more years of association with you....

featured_reviews.name: Pramila Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a pleasure working with Ushma, an incredibly talented & extraordinary Choreographer for our Sangeet function !

Ushma crafted each performance with such creativity and attention to detail, ensuring that every family member felt comfortable and confident. Her ability to tailor the choreography to suit everyone's dancing style, regardless of their age & experience, was truly impressive.

Our entire family and friends had so much fun during the practice sessions, which were filled with laughter and joy. Ushma's positive energy and dedication turned our vision into reality, making our sangeet function unforgettable.

We wholeheartedly recommend Ushma to anyone looking to add a touch of magic to their celebrations. Thank you for creating memories we will cherish forever!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words! It truly means the world to us. Your support and enthusiasm inspire us to keep dancing and creating magic together!

featured_reviews.name: Priyal Dodhia
featured_reviews.review_text: I contacted Ushma for my sister's Sangeet and the moment I spoke to her, I knew she was the choreographer I was looking for and would do an amazing job. She made us fall in love with the choreography and it really showed during the performances. She was on top of everything, right from communication to looking at minute details of the choreography. It had been the first time in the family that the girl gang was doing a performance and it went so smooth, all thanks to Ushma. My parents and the girls and especially my sister loved the choreography so much and it really showed in the performance. Absolutely recommend her!! Thank you again Ushma🫶🏻💖🥰
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for such a heartfelt review. Truly means a lot to us. We are glad to read this. Choreographing your sister’s sangeet and working with your family was an absolute joy. You all were really amazing on stage. Thank you so much once again for the trust and the lovely recommendation.

featured_reviews.name: jinal shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I've know Ushma ma’am from  last 7 to 8 years. She is not only one of the best choreographer and dancer but also a genuinely kind person. She is very down-to-earth, polite, helpful, and incredibly creative. In all these years, I have never seen her raise her voice. She handles every situation with grace and always remains composed. Despite being a trainer or teacher, she has never behaved like one; she has always been friendly with us, teaching us with love and dedication. She is highly committed and serious about her profession, and her hard work over the past 7 to 8 years has helped her grow to where she is today. I can’t fully express how happy I am for her, but I highly recommend joining her dance class. You will also have a great experience. Thank you.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your valuable feedback. your kind words really motivate us to work better n better. We are glad to serve you ♥️ We believe in maintaining friends like relations with our clients! Thank you

featured_reviews.name: Vidya Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently Had a wonderful experience learning from Ushma ganatra for our family sangeet event,she’s an awesome dancer and an excellent choreographer ..she choreographed all the songs keeping every one’s dancing style in mind i can say this on behalf of my entire family we thoroughly enjoyed every moment .
Thank you .
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We’re so touched by your kind words! It’s students like you that make House of Dance a special place. Keep shining and dancing!

featured_reviews.name: nishita dodhia
featured_reviews.review_text: Ushma, made our girls group dance performance for sangeet function so easy and comfortable. We enjoyed and felt so confident to perform on stage. Thank you and keep going..!!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your valuable feedback. Choreographing your sangeet performances and seeing you all enjoy the process was pleasure. We r glad to knw that girls felt confident & comfortable with the steps. Thank you for trusting us.

featured_reviews.name: kinjal shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have known ushma ma’am since 2 years. She is one of the best choreographers for kids as well as adults. She has a wonderful way of dealing with kids. My son loves to go to her dance class and has learnt quite a lot from her in one year.

Ushma ma’am is also very creative and unique with adults’ dances. We did a couple of stage performances with her and absolutely loved her dance forms as well as her way of teaching.❤️❤️
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your valuable feedback. We are glad to hear from you & such reviews really motivates us to work better & better. We Heartily enjoyed choreographing you♥️

featured_reviews.name: Nishita Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very nice experince
For a non dancer Ushma made it so comfortable and doable..
I enjoyed dancing and learning it from her..
do recommend for dance and any dance related functions 😊🥰
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We are truly happy to hear that you felt comfortable with the choreography. We enjoyed choreographing for your family. Thank you for the lovely recommendation.

featured_reviews.name: Devika Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Ushma
A huge thank you for bringing so much energy and joy to our Mehndi function dances! Your choreography was absolutely stunning, and we couldn't have done it without you!"
You were an absolute pleasure to work with, and your choreography was top-notch and we are incredibly thankful towards you and also look forward to working with you again

Thank you once again ♥️🤩🫂
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: So happy to hear this! Your journey with us is as special to us as it is to you. Keep dancing and spreading the joy!
